1.question: What is Daily Budget?
1.answer: Daily Budget turns your budget into 'covered days'. Instead of just numbers, you see how many days you can live with the money you have left.

2.question: How do I record an expense?
2.answer: Press the '+' button on the main screen. Enter the amount, select a category (Food, Transport, Leisure, Health, Other) and add an optional note. The expense is automatically deducted from your budget.

3.question: What do the colors of the progress ring mean?
3.answer: The ring shows your remaining budget percentage. Green: safe (>70%), Orange: close to limit (30-70%), Red: critical (<30%) or saving mode active.

4.question: What is 'Saving mode'?
4.answer: It activates when you spend more than 120% of the ideal daily amount or when your remaining budget is negative. It helps you identify that you need to reduce expenses.

5.question: Can I delete an expense?
5.answer: Yes. In history, tap the trash icon on the expense row, confirm deletion, and the budget will be automatically recovered.

6.question: How does the history work?
6.answer: All transactions are grouped by day. Tap any row to see details. Scroll down to load more items (infinite pagination).

7.question: Is my data safe?
7.answer: Yes. All data is stored only on your device. You can also enable biometric lock (fingerprint) and make encrypted backups from Settings.

8.question: Can I change my budget or duration?
8.answer: Currently you can edit your plan from Settings > 'Your current plan' (coming soon). Meanwhile, you can reset the vault (delete all data) and reconfigure from scratch.

9.question: How do I export my data?
9.answer: Go to Settings > Export data. You can generate a CSV file with your expenses or create an encrypted backup protected by biometrics.
